patch.origin: Ampullary (centred on the ampulla of Vater, including intra-ampullary and periampullary-duodenal)

report:
(A) Bile duct margin
(B) Ampulla of Vater, pancreas and duodenum, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)

(A) Received in a fresh state is a piece of tan coloured tissue. All embedded in 1 frozen block and subsequently converted to paraffin block.

(B) Received in formalin is a pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection) specimen measuring 150 x 90 x 60 mm. The pancreatic head measures 55 x 45 x 35 mm, the attached duodenum measures 150 mm in length and the common bile duct measures 40 mm in length. The pancreatic neck, bile duct, uncinate (superior mesenteric artery) and posterior surfaces are inked in different colours and the neck and bile duct margins are taken en face. There is a firm, ill-defined pale tumour centred on the ampulla of Vater measuring 18 x 15 x 10 mm. The common bile duct is dilated to 16 mm and the pancreatic duct is dilated to 5 mm. The ampulla is bisected along the probed common bile duct and pancreatic duct and embedded in full. The lymph node stations are dissected separately and submitted in labelled cassettes. Representative sections are taken; see block key.

(B1-6) Ampulla, bisected along the probed ducts.
(B7) Pancreatic neck margin, en face.
(B8) Bile duct margin, en face.

(A) Carcinoma present at the bile duct margin.

(A) The paraffin section confirms the frozen section diagnosis. It shows infiltrating carcinoma involving the bile duct margin.

(B) Ampulla of Vater, pancreas and duodenum, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)
Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple resection)
- Origin: Ampullary (centred on the ampulla of Vater, including intra-ampullary
  and periampullary-duodenal)
- Tumour site: Intra-ampullary
- Tumour size: 1.8 cm (unifocal invasive carcinoma, greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Adenocarcinoma, pancreaticobiliary-type
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated adenocarcinoma,
  pancreaticobiliary-type, invading the pancreas to a depth of 0.3 cm. Simple
  angulated glands and small cell clusters lined by a single layer of cuboidal
  to low columnar cells are set in desmoplastic stroma, the nuclei round with
  prominent nucleoli and without pseudostratification. The tumour cells express
  CK7 and MUC1 and are negative for CDX2.
- Sites involved by direct extension: Invades the pancreas (depth 0.3 cm)
- Depth of pancreatic invasion: 0.3 cm
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Present
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Precursor lesion: Intra-ampullary papillary-tubular neoplasm (IAPN)

Margins
- Pancreatic neck (transection) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 15 mm
- Bile duct margin: Involved by invasive carcinoma
- Uncinate (retroperitoneal / superior mesenteric artery) margin: Uninvolved by
  invasive carcinoma, 6 mm
- Posterior surface: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 5 mm
- Proximal (gastric or duodenal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 50 mm
- Distal (duodenal or jejunal) margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 55 mm
- Pancreatic duct margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 14 mm
- Duodenal mucosal margin: Uninvolved by invasive carcinoma, 48 mm
- High-grade dysplasia at the margins: Not identified

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 16 examined; 2 involved
  - Number examined: 16
  - Number involved: 2
  - Stations involved: 13 (posterior pancreaticoduodenal): 2
  - Extranodal extension: Not identified
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 4 mm, station 13

Distant metastasis
- Distant metastasis: Not identified

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT3a pN1
  - Stage group (if cM0): IIIA

Additional findings
- Ampullary adenoma

(A) BILE DUCT MARGIN, frozen section - INVOLVED BY CARCINOMA

(B) AMPULLA OF VATER, pancreas and duodenum, pancreaticoduodenectomy (Whipple
resection)
- ADENOCARCINOMA, pancreaticobiliary-type, moderately differentiated, 1.8 cm,
  invading the pancreas to a depth of 0.3 cm; perineural invasion present; bile
  duct margin involved; remaining margins clear (closest 5 mm); see synoptic
  report
- 2 of 16 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT3a pN1 (AJCC 8th edition), stage IIIA (if cM0)
